blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — New facilities at the National Kidney and Transplant Institute (NKTI) and the Philippine Cancer Center (PCC) are expected to begin operations by late 2027 to early 2028, with the projects now at Phase 3 of construction, government officials said on Tuesday. Health Secretary Edwin Mercado said the government is challenging the contractor to complete the NKTI extension by the end of 2027, although the more likely target is the first quarter of 2028. “We’re challenging our contractor to see if we can finish it by the end of 2027.
